Name: Custom Cask Aging
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]
Custom Cask Aging lets you set an aging speed for each thing a cask takes: cheese, goat cheese, wine, mead, pale ale and beer. Set wine to 2x and it ages twice as fast, so gold wine becomes iridium in 14 days instead of 28. Pick anything from 0.1x to 100x for each, like 2.25x or 10x.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Six settings, one for each of [b]Cheese[/b], [b]Goat cheese[/b], [b]Wine[/b], [b]Mead[/b], [b]Pale ale[/b] and [b]Beer[/b], in Generic Mod Config Menu, or [font=Courier New]CheeseMultiplier[/font], [font=Courier New]GoatCheeseMultiplier[/font], [font=Courier New]WineMultiplier[/font], [font=Courier New]MeadMultiplier[/font], [font=Courier New]PaleAleMultiplier[/font] and [font=Courier New]BeerMultiplier[/font] in the mod's config.json.[/*]
[*]Each setting multiplies that item's own speed, so cheese is still faster than wine. At 1x nothing changes.[/*]
[*]It speeds up what is already in your casks, not only what you put in afterwards.[/*]
[*]It works alongside Custom Cask Mod. Anything Custom Cask Mod adds, or that you set in its CaskData.json, keeps its own rate.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu to change the speeds in game.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Source and support[/b][/size]
The source is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]. Please report bugs and make suggestions there, as GitHub issues.
